scientific_integrity: All code witnesses and all conflict-clique upper-bound evidence are included as complete independently re-enumerable finite data, accompanied by a standard-library checker; no claim for larger length or uniqueness is made.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite lengths 4 through 12 only. The fixed-weight word counts and unrestricted code theory are previously known. Possible unindexed prior restricted code results have not been excluded. This proof has not had independent mathematical evaluation.
title: First primitive-necklace packing deficit for constant-weight-four non-overlapping binary codes
